jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Corporate Strategy

Job Description

Strategy Group summary:
Founded by former strategy consultants, Capital One is a strategy driven company. The Corporate Strategy group engages on a number of ultra-high impact issues that drive the direction and performance of the company. Projects focus primarily on formulating enduring and profitable growth and value enhancement strategies, while working within the business to ensure follow through.
The Corporate Research team (within Corporate Strategy) serves as Capital One’s competitive intelligence team, leveraging data, research, and financial analysis to provide company leadership with competitive and market intelligence, insights and advice, and strategic communications.

Position summary:
As an analyst on the Corporate Research team, you will collaborate with C-suite executives, Strategy, Investor Relations, Finance, and various other teams across the company to provide research support, market insight, and company-wide communication. You will work on a variety of different initiatives in a close team environment. Many of the day-to-day projects emphasize a need for strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Key to success in the role will be synthesizing information from various sources, performing analysis, and integrating findings into cohesive and insightful presentations and summaries.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Provide analytical support to senior management across the company

- Provide recurring and ad hoc research to support various business lines and internal partners

- Benchmark Capital One’s performance vs. industry competitors

- Daily monitoring of financial and economic events to inform senior leadership how they impact Capital One

- Analysis of large financial data sets (Fed, FDIC, Census, etc.)

- ‘Deep dives’ and longer-term projects on a wide range of topics relevant to Capital One

- Ad hoc project work with partner teams (Strategy, Corporate Development)

- Analyze and benchmark Capital One and competitor capital and balance sheet performance (including CCAR, DFAST, funding profile, regulatory disclosures, etc.)

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree

- At least 2 years of consulting or investment banking experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of analytical rigor and attention to detail

- Interest or experience with the banking or payments industries

- Financial modeling or investment research expertise

- Strong judgment and problem-solving skills

- Team player with a positive attitude

- Naturally inquisitive with a passion to “figure stuff out”

- Confidence and intent to drive change

jobs.description:
Principal Associate - Program Manager- Product College

Imagine being a part of an enterprise wide initiative that is at the forefront of how we approach product management across Capital One. The Product College team is focused on designing and executing learning experiences that support our product management competencies and play an integral role in how we grow our product talent and reputation in the market. Our team is collaborative, creative and passionate about helping our associates grow in their careers.

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team as Program Managers, with an opportunity to lead either our Product Onboarding or our Product Manager Machine Learning programs. As a member of the Product College team, the Principal Associate will be responsible for partnering closely with key business partners in Capital One’s Product organizations to deliver practical and immersive learning experiences. This role will coordinate the delivery of self-paced and cohort programmatic experiences, both in-person and virtually, to meet Product associates where they are and get them where they need to be—whether that is navigating their first 90 days at Capital One or upskilling in cutting-edge machine learning strategies. This role will partner closely with the leaders, instructional designers, Product associates, and other stakeholders to deliver a best-in-class program

The ideal candidate for this position:
- Has excellent project management skills; autonomously drives projects, logistics and strategy forward using sound judgment and critical thinking.
- Has experience delivering dynamic immersive learning experiences, with a particular focus on cohort learning and program execution.
- Dynamically adapts their communication style across verbal and written channels (e.g., Slack, email) to keep participants, facilitators, and executives engaged and apprised of important details.
- Has a consultative skill set and builds trust-based relationships to partner effectively with a wide range of clients, senior leaders and subject matter experts (including AI/ML technical leaders).
- Is highly data-driven and detail-oriented, with a keen ability to organize, synthesize, and analyze data to measure impact and drive continuous program improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- End-to-end program ownership: Own the day-to-day execution, annual strategy, and iteration of their program within Product College. Ensure a high-quality, associate-centric experience across the learner journey.
- Stakeholder & speaker management: Identify, brief, and seamlessly integrate executive product speakers, SMEs, and facilitators into the curriculum to ensure high-impact delivery. Maintain strong relationships with the Accountable Executive and key stakeholders to achieve the program's vision and adjust course based on internal and industry shifts.
- Data-driven continuous improvement: Analyze pre and post-session surveys and conduct comprehensive retrospective meetings after each cohort to identify themes and measure impact. Coordinate with necessary partners, including data teams, consultants, and instructional designers, to implement systemic, data-backed curriculum enhancements.
- Operations & budget integrity: Manage program budgets, external vendor relationships, track learner data and distribution lists, and coordinate the complex virtual and in-person logistics required to scale the program smoothly across multiple locations.
- Live session production: Act as a host and producer for learners during live learning sessions, managing immediate logistics such as facilitator preparedness, Zoom recordings, attendance tracking, and materials archiving.
- Program advocacy & communication: Manage all ongoing program communications (formal and informal) via Slack and email. Drive awareness and marketing efforts for the program within the broader Capital One product community and across other internal onboarding teams.
- Process excellence: Work on individual and team initiatives to design, build, and implement new scalable processes that ensure efficient, reliable, and resilient program delivery.

We recognize that many life paths can contribute to interest in this role. We value all experience, whether gained in a classroom or through other paths, and invite everyone who meets the below requirements to apply for this role.

Basic Qualifications
- High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent certification
- At least 2 years of experience in learning and development
- At least 1 year of experience in Program or Project Management, or a combination
- At least 1 year of consulting experience

Preferred Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in learning and development
- 2+ years of experience in Program or Project Management
- 2+ years of consulting experience
- Process or Project Management Certification

jobs.description:
Treasury Management Consultant III, Specialized Industries

This role is centered on generating new and expanding existing full-service treasury management relationships for Sponsor and Specialized Industries clients. The Treasury Management Consultant (TMC) will be responsible for directly and/or indirectly selling and maintaining depository accounts and the treasury management services applied to those accounts for both new and existing Capital One relationships.

The Treasury Management Consultant will partner with internal stakeholders to be a single point of accountability or provide advice on the deposit, treasury management, risk, and other company liquidity needs of prospects and clients. Together, they will build a book of business through deposit growth, maintaining and cross-selling to existing clients, and prospecting for new-to-bank relationships.

The Treasury Management Consultant will focus on specific verticals within the Specialty Organization. Familiarity with these business verticals and the specific banking and financial operations of Technology, Media, Telecom (TMT) or Financial Institutions Group (FIG) clients is desirable. This TMC will also concentrate on working with dedicated TMT or FIG  Relationship Managers and leadership to generate new-to-bank relationships, while developing existing clients by delivering value-added solutions and collaborating across the product and technology organizations to optimize products for evolving client needs, with a focus on bringing in new deposits.

The Treasury Management Sales team works to identify ways to improve the client experience and enhance Capital One's brand in the marketplace. Seen as a trusted advisor, the TMC will work closely with commercial clients to understand their business, optimize treasury flow, and minimize financial and reputational risk. They will focus on creating and delivering customized, client-centric solutions through a consultative approach. Leveraging their network and collaborating across business lines, the TMC will influence strategy to meet the needs of clients while using sound judgment in assessing risk. The TMC will foster a spirit of teamwork and cooperation across value streams. This position works independently and uses initiative in carrying out assignments, requiring minimal guidance from the sales leader.

Responsibilities:
- Identifies both internal and external prospects. Develops and maintains relationships with prospects to profitably expand business

- Provides thought leadership within and outside the market through, but not limited to, hosting corporate events, attending and speaking at industry conferences, etc.

- Engages with internal marketing in the design of sales collateral and company-sponsored marketing

- Manages portfolio of existing clients with focus on profitable, organic revenue growth and minimizing attrition

- Manages portfolio of new-to-bank clients with focus on revenue growth

- Develops and maintains relationships with clients to maintain and expand existing business

- Knows business’s, organization, expected activity; identifies and communicates operational credit exposures and other risks

- Understands treasury management product risk and ensures Capital One credit policies and other risks (e.g., reputational, legal) are adhered to and mitigated

- Establishes appropriate expectations for onboarding including execution of documentation and ensure ramp of sold services

- Conducts independent and codependent sales calls on companies to generate new, high-quality and profitable Treasury Management and deposit business to achieve or exceed specific YoY growth goals

- Takes a role in market by actively engaging in local industry associations, networking groups and/or community associations

- Identifies working capital efficiency opportunities for a business and deepens relationship accordingly; ensures business awareness of market and industry trends; identifies dissatisfiers and escalates appropriately

- Identifies and refers ancillary business opportunities to appropriate partners

- Designs customer-centric treasury management solutions, and provides consultative expertise on the liquidity management cycle

Basic Qualifications:
- High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification

- At least 6 years of financial services experience

- At least 5 years of sales experience

- At least 5 years of treasury management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 7 years of treasury management experience

- In-depth to advanced treasury management product knowledge

- Effective oral and written communication skills

- Certified Treasury Professional designation or equivalent certification

Principal Associate, Chief of Staff - Global Payments Network

Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our mission is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

As a Principal Associate Project Manager on the Integration program team, you will drive operational excellence by delivering impactful solutions for associates and customers while supporting strategic cross-functional projects that deliver direct organizational value. This role involves navigating ambiguity by taking high-level, complex questions and independently structuring actionable plans to solve them.

You will act as a key thought partner to team leadership and stakeholders, leveraging data-backed decisioning to influence outcomes, manage competing priorities, and enable efficient team operations. We are seeking an adaptable, analytical project leader capable of turning abstract problems into structured execution while building strong cross-functional alignment. Excellent communication skills are essential.

General Responsibilities:
- Operational Excellence & Associate/Customer Solutions: Manage key operational workflows and leadership forums to ensure seamless execution. Build well-managed, sustainable, and scalable solutions that address friction points for associates and drive better outcomes for customers.

- Strategic Problem Solving & Project Delivery: Structure ambiguous "white space" problems by taking high-level questions and independently executing plans to answer them. Drive work forward autonomously, establishing and socializing timelines and workback schedules to set clear expectations with stakeholders. Push thinking beyond initial problems toward second-order insights to create repeatable solutions that solve future issues.

- Executive Communication & Storytelling: Develop compelling, data-driven presentations for senior audiences (with guidance from your manager). Bring structure to complex work so that it is repeatable and easily communicated. Articulate the business value of deliverables clearly to team members, key stakeholders, and partners.

- Thought Partnership & Influence: Act as a sounding board for your manager and step in for your manager in strategic conversations when necessary. Pull together data to support cohesive narratives, and push back on decision-making with logic, evidence, and data insights when appropriate. Show up as a consultant to others within your area of expertise.

- Stakeholder Management & Customer Focus: Build relationships and effectively collaborate with key partners to understand customer needs. Maintain a responsive service mindset, iterating with partners to guide them to the right solution while consistently setting and managing expectations.

- Teamwork & Culture: Routinely collaborate with a network of peers to share best practices, train teammates, and build community. Jump in to support others outside your immediate scope when bandwidth allows, providing leverage to the broader team.

The Ideal Candidate Will:
- Structure White Space: Demonstrate a proven ability to deal well with ambiguity—stepping into white space, making sense of it, and structuring repeatable plans to drive results.

- Exercise Grounded Judgment: Demonstrate data-backed decision-making, identifying and focusing on the highest-priority work while validating priorities with leadership when necessary.

- Drive Well-Managed Execution: Be detail- and action-oriented, operating with a sense of urgency, building sustainable processes, and leveraging a strong network to get work done.

- Communicate & Influence with Data: Exhibit strong written and verbal communication skills, framing complex work clearly, presenting business value, and influencing stakeholders through logic and data insights.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or Military experience

- At least 3 Years Project Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Masters or MBA degree

- At least 5 years of Project Management experience

- PMP, Lean, Agile or Six Sigma certification

We're seeking someone who can seamlessly connect business objectives with learning solutions, translating strategic ideas into impactful, learner-centered experiences. Whether your background is in strategy, business, program/product management, or learning strategy, your ability to build relationships with stakeholders and create alignment to drive progress will be critical. If you are energized by creative problem solving, creating transformational learning, building strong relationships, and managing through complexity to deliver business impact–this role is for you.

The ideal candidate for this role is…
- Strategic Learning Partner: Anticipates future learning needs by staying current with talent development and technology trends, thinks and solves problems systemically, balances long-term vision with execution rigor, and brings structure to ambiguity while managing competing priorities

Senior Manager, Finance - Treasury

Senior Manager, Finance - Treasury

Do you want to leverage your analytical skills and be part of an exciting, fast-paced environment surrounded by smart, inclusive, and energetic individuals? Come and join our Capital One Travel Treasury team!

As a Senior Manager, Treasury, you will play a critical role in shaping our strategic direction while ensuring a well-managed operational environment. You will be at the forefront of identifying and mitigating risks, overseeing a team of treasury professionals, and acting as a key partner to our Senior Director. The ideal candidate will bring a horizontal mindset, an analytical eye, and a proven ability to lead cross-functional coordination. With an increasing volume of complex cash management requests, we are looking for a strategic thinker who can design robust funding strategies while maintaining flawless execution and a strong control environment.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):
- Strategic Treasury Ownership : Own liquidity and cash management, cash forecasting methodology, treasury KPIs and dashboards, funding strategy, and bank account strategy and controls.

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. Our product team is part of a larger group focused on the transformation of Finance at Capital One.  The Corporate Development arm of Finance is responsible for assisting in creating new partnerships for our lines of business in addition to identifying possible acquisitions. The product team is a close partner in solving for how we accelerate time to value in these engagements.

The Director, Product Management for Corporate Development Integration is a unique and high profile role that is responsible for taking a holistic view of how we assimilate and integrate an acquired company into the Finance ecosystem.  You’ll work across the Finance portfolio shaping the strategy for how and when we integrate systems and assist the teams responsible for delivering on their individual parts of this agenda to engage effectively with their new counterparts.  You will be the wide angle lens on the strategy for how we integrate as well as the glue to keep the individual workstreams aligned.

In addition to your contributions on overall portfolio and product strategies, you’ll also play a key role in building our Product Management organization. You’ll help shape our culture and our people, provide mentorship for your teammates and be an ambassador for Product Management across the Finance organization.

Capital One is seeking a culture-led, results-driven, and strategic problem solver to join the FP&A Tech Finance team as a Manager supporting Enterprise Data (eData). As a Manager, you will provide leadership by forging relationships, leveraging insights to influence business actions, and acting as a work lead and mentor to empower junior members of the team to deliver their best work.

About the Enterprise Data (eData) Team

Since the beginning, Capital One has leveraged data to drive strategic decisions and create value for customers. The Enterprise Data (eData) organization is at the heart of this mission, building a modern data ecosystem of platforms, products, and processes. Our goal is to ensure data is well-managed, easy to govern, and easy to find, understand, and use so the business can deliver real-time, intelligent experiences. What You Bring to the Team
- Intellectually Curious & Transparent: High personal and professional integrity, coupled with exceptional problem-solving skills, a desire to solve big problems, dig deeply into the truth through data, and maintain a high bar for excellence.

Are you an expert at deconstructing complex "tribal knowledge" into elegant, scalable systems? The Talent Management Performance Management Operational Excellence (TMPM OE) team is seeking a Process Strategist to move our talent and performance management operations from institutional memory, manually-heavy processes to institutional excellence. You will be the primary bridge between operational intent and execution, ensuring our processes are so clearly defined that they serve as the foundational blueprints for our Product Partners and process automation.

Key Responsibilities:
- Knowledge Externalization: Audit current "institutional knowledge" across the team to create high-fidelity process maps and logic trees. Ensure these processes are understandable by non-experts, specifically Product Partners and Product Ops.
- Systematic Optimization: Proactively identify friction points
in the existing processes. Leverage systematic thinking, AI tools, & partnership with programming team members to redesign these workflows for maximum efficiency before they are prioritized on the product development roadmap.
- Product Requirement Architecture: Translate optimized operational workflows into clear, logic-based requirements. You will ensure that product enhancements are built to support a "future-state" process rather than automating existing manual workarounds. Success is measured by the completeness of operational requirements provided to Product Partners; your goal is the total elimination of missed process dependencies prior to release.
- Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with Product Operations to integrate these refined processes into their user support and incident management models, ensuring a seamless experience from back-end operations to front-line support.
- Intelligent Automation Inputs: Work ahead of the roadmap to prepare data and process logic that are automation ready enabling the team to quickly leverage emerging technologies for automated decisioning and reporting.
- Global Scalability: Ensure all process designs are modular and adaptable for international markets, removing regional "shadow processes" in favor of a unified global standard through partnership with Risk.
- End-to-End Workflow Redesign : Champion the holistic redesign of work processes and structures by deploying intelligent automation across repetitive processes while focusing on achieving system-level efficiency.

Success looks like:
- Systems Thinking: The ability to see the "big picture" of the talent & performance management ecosystem and understand how a change in one area impacts the entire lifecycle.
- Information Design: Mastery of process mapping tools (e.g., LucidChart, Visio) and the ability to turn "messy" conversations into structured documentation.
- Automation Curiosity: Practical experience or a strong aptitude for using systematic or AI tools to streamline workflows, draft documentation, or analyze process data.
- Translational Communication: The ability to speak "Operation" to the current team,”Programming Needs” to Analytic Partners, "Requirement" to the Product Managers, and "Support" to Product Ops.
- Bias for Clarity: A relentless drive to eliminate ambiguity. You aren't satisfied until a process is so clear it can be understood by someone on their first day.

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
- At least 4 years in process, project management, or operations

Preferred Qualifications:
- 4+ years of successfully championing major process or system transformations/implementations

Farnborough (95987), United Kingdom, Farnborough,

Payments Settlement Operations Lead

Job Title: Payments Settlement Operations Lead

Location: Farnborough, London - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 2 days in-office and 3 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

This role will have a wide range of responsibilities as part of a team managing settlement balancing, and reconciliations. This position will also be part of the team liaison to the enterprise-wide Legal, Compliance and Business Risk functions. This person will help to develop business-unit specific approaches and ensure accurate and timely implementation across all risk management disciplines and all areas in the International Settlement organization. This individual will support the business compliance and operational risk/control activities within Settlement which may include risk assessment, controls, procedure documentation, process design, control workflow/systems, reporting, testing, remediation and third-party management. This individual will evaluate current operations across International Settlement, to identify areas for enhancements and work with business partners to implement these processes. Actively manages and escalates risk and customer-impacting issues within the day-to-day role to management.

What you’ll do

- Provide financial and operational support on the DCI Settlement System daily controls, ensuring Settlement balances daily, and ensuring achievement of team objectives.
- Research and resolve daily Settlement discrepancies, Production issues and customer inquiries, collaborating with Business Partners to meet customer needs, in line with Risk and Compliance goals.
- Lead the team’s response to past due payments, including funds owed to and from DCI’s settlement agent. Ensure swift resolution of outstanding payments by collaborating with cross-functional teams and settlement agent contacts, actively removing roadblocks as necessary.
- Coach and mentor team members to provide premier customer service within SLAs, with a focus on expansion of knowledge with team members based Offshore. Provide cross training on team functions to maintain bench strength and ensure no single point of failure.
- Build the team’s knowledge on the DCI Balancing functions, ensuring all processes are mapped and documented with suitable controls in place, through ‘Operational Excellence’ tools and practices.
- Proactively identify improvement and automation opportunities, to facilitate continuous process improvements on daily controls, and mitigate future errors.
- Identify, investigate and implement opportunities for introduction of AI into daily controls activities, leveraging Gemini tools and acting as trailblazer for AI activities within the team.
- Act as a subject matter expert for all operational matters regarding clients’ use of the DCI Settlement system, building strategic relationships across multiple partners.
- Lead priority projects as necessary, taking ownership to fulfil requirements. Balance conflicting priorities as needed to ensure timely completion, and proactively provide progress updates.

The skills and experience you need

- Cross functional knowledge of the Payment Network Industry focusing on Financial Services, Compliance, Internal Audit, Risk or Operations.
- Google Suite knowledge and expertise, particularly in AI (Gemini and GEMS)
- Effective written and verbal communication skills with all levels of employees and management; including managing expectations, communicating issues, risks and opportunities.
- Certification in Control Self Assessment, Certified Internal Auditor, Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager

Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in our Farnborough office .
We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend two days a week in the office.

What’s in it for you
We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.
In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

- Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes

Principal Associate, Benefits Plan Program Management

The Principal Associate, Benefits Plan Program Management plays a critical role in ensuring the seamless delivery, administration, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Health & Wellness and voluntary benefit programs. This individual serves as a key operational anchor, managing a portfolio of vendors (e.g., on-site clinics, dental, vision, mental health, education, family support and commuter), resolving complex issues, and supporting the successful execution of strategic initiatives and Request for Proposal (RFP) processes.  This individual must be able to work independently to drive work forward with support from internal and external partners.

Key Responsibilities
1. Vendor Management & Governance
- Own Plan Program Management for on-site clinics and pharmacies, dental, vision, life insurance, LTD, AD&PL, mental health, family formation and support, MSK, executive physicals, and commuter benefits.  Develop a network and build trust-based relationships with vendors and cross-functional partners to get work done.

- Performance Monitoring: Attend regular partner meetings and actively monitor vendor adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and performance guarantees (PGs) to ensure vendors deliver on contracts.

- Partner with Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) to execute all required vendor management tasks to ensure compliance and mitigate risk (e.g.,  business reviews, risk assessments, data share requests).

- Manage processes for on-site clinic staffing, including updating access in our vendor management portal and ensuring physical access to the campus.

- Continuous Improvement: Create analytics to leverage data to generate insights on vendor capabilities and recommend plan or program improvements based on benchmarking data, areas of employee abrasion, compliance updates, or emerging market trends.  Considers broader and longer term impact to create value. Stay up to date on new programs or offerings from vendors and support the Policy & Design team with input on investment decisions.

2. Operations & Program Administration
- Issue & Escalation Resolution: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date issue logs for each vendor. Drive timely resolution of tracking items and document outcomes.

- Manage annual program implementation changes with vendors (excluding Workday feeds). Ensure changes are properly implemented and tested.

- Core Administration: Handle all administrative tasks related to the assigned plans with a sense of urgency, while balancing quality, to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. Navigate any ambiguity to assess various situations to determine the proper course of action.

- Internal Communications: Own and maintain internal intranet pages for your plans to ensure benefit program information, FAQs, and resources are accurate and accessible. Partner with HR Communications to make needed changes.

3. Associate Experience
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Own complex, tier-3 employee escalations for your plans end-to-end. Work with members to understand the situation, investigate root causes, interface with vendors for resolutions, and implement processes or solutions to prevent future errors.

- Understand associate experience (how claims flow, customer service support, etc) to recommend and execute improvements.

- Oversee the monthly benefits and wellbeing newsletter to increase plan utilization and drive awareness of benefits.  Develop a project plan with monthly themes, partner with stakeholders to provide relevant content, socialize as needed to support key HR initiatives, and work with HR Communications on production.

- Leverage data to support key messages and partner with HR Communications to design and execute on a communications plan to drive understanding of benefit and how to access/ use. Review communications recommended by vendors and partner with HR Comms on a view point for which should be sent, and timing.  Provide input into the monthly wellbeing newsletter.

4. Strategic Initiatives & Growth
- RFP & RFI Support: Support team members responsible for plan design with Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Request for Information (RFIs) for new or expiring benefit programs, including evaluating vendor bids and participating in stakeholder reviews

- Implementation Support: Handle program implementation changes with vendors; ensure changes are properly implemented and tested.

- Proactively seeks out benefits knowledge to stay current on benefits products, industry innovations, and regulatory changes by attending webinars, reading industry publications, and participating in conferences.

5. Documentation
- Process Documentation: Author and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for vendor management and escalation workflows to ensure team business continuity.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree or military experience

- 3+ years of experience working with H&W employee benefit plan vendor management

- Preferred Qualifications

- MBA or Master’s Degree

- Certified Employee Benefit Specialist (CEBS) or Certified Benefits Professional (CBP) designation

- 4 years of experience in H&W employee benefits for organizations with 10,000+ employees

- 5 years of experience with benefits vendor management

- Experience with benefits governance practices

- Solid business acumen, strategic thinker, and problem solver

- Strong analytical skills and knowledge of statistical analysis
